notes.title: Marron's Day Storyteller and Switch Release Sale!
notes.notes:
Marron's Day, my cute retro adventure game, is on sale for the Storyteller's Festival and to celebrate the release on Nintendo Switch! (It'll be releasing on February 20th at different times depending on your region!) That means you can play it on both a very old Nintendo console and the newest one 🐰🥕 You can also as usual play this game however you want on Steam - computer, Steam Deck, wherever!

Storyteller's Festival celebrates lovely narrative games so you should take a look at all of them!

notes.title: Marron's Day is out now! 🐰
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/ca13958e29262e68625a228581f46c89a9ae54be.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/ca13958e29262e68625a228581f46c89a9ae54be.gif[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/540f0c6242e0c9a54e65ae403f374355d73d9ba3.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/540f0c6242e0c9a54e65ae403f374355d73d9ba3.gif[/img][/url] 

[h3]Marron's Day is out NOW![/h3]

Marron's Day is a silly pocket-sized adventure where you're a bunny trying to save the town festival! Help out your animal friends, play cute minigames, and explore this cosy and retro pixel-art town. 

I hope you'll enjoy! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/76de94e3e5933f70135b9c87d9216686fcbbee92.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620590/Marrons_Day/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2640690/Marrons_Day_Soundtrack/

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Demo for Marron's Day!
notes.notes:
Marron's Day has a new demo for Steam Next Fest with help from RAWRLAB Games - check out the spiffy new look! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/5f7da7ae6ce3e3985f9f967b2805aff310c8811e.png[/img]

The full game will have lots more extras to enjoy, but you can have a little taste in the demo first 🍬 (Also, take a peek in the EXTRAS folder if you'd prefer to play the demo on a different device... 👀)

We'll have a proper controller legend in the full version, but for the demo, here is an explanation of the controls:

Arrow keys: D-pad (movement)
S key: A button (confirm, use fishing rod)
A key: B button (cancel, reel in fish)

Hope you enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44708671/6685eb55fe9b8c98d7bc54aaea28d98c3abff376.png[/img]

notes.title: Silly adventure game Marron's Day coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello! I just launched the Steam page for my new game, Marron's Day! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/1f85862df610561c7cf21479e11566b460dcaadd.gif[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42184151/60a209afb154364d2b00a8dfef1588cf64319573.gif[/img] 

Marron's Day is a silly adventure game where you're a bunny! You love your friends but love carrots even more. Explore the town, run errands for your animal friends, and don't let anyone catch you swiping the carrots from the garden (again)! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2620590/Marrons_Day/

Explore town, help your friends... and steal carrots?

Wishlist this retro bunny adventure now! 🐰
